claims.evidence: No engine plate, cover branding, or VIN/part number visible in the report; witness only identified it generically as 'used car engine'.
No readable casting number, engine code sticker, or model tag mentioned in observations.
Origin/import status cannot be determined from a static photo; no customs sticker or shipping tag noted.
No warranty card, receipt, or seller guarantee document shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be a Toyota Camry unit (wrong make/model/displacement)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of engine block casting number, VIN/engine ID plate, or valve cover branding
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used engine, not Camry-specific

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression loss, bearing wear, piston scoring)
risks.proof: Video of engine cranking/running, or a compression test reading

risks.risk: Missing accessories needed for installation (starter, injectors, sensors, ECU, wiring harness)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing all mounting points and accessory brackets
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming bare block only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/hours and true wear level
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or service history document

risks.risk: Reason for removal (accident vs failure vs upgrade) affecting hidden damage
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle or accident/removal documentation

risks.risk: Claimed 'guarantee' may be unenforceable or nonexistent
risks.proof: Photo of written warranty terms or receipt with seller's verifiable contact/business details
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold with no guarantee

proof_requests: Close-up photo of engine ID plate, block casting number, or any OEM part sticker
Video of the engine running or being cranked over
Full set of photos showing all sides of the engine and presence/absence of starter, alternator, injectors, sensors, ECU
Any compression test or mechanic inspection report
Photo of the donor vehicle (if available) or documentation of removal reason
Photo of any warranty/guarantee document or receipt
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a genuine used engine assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified make/model, unproven running condition, no guaranteed accessories) pending the listed proofs to raise the price.
